All five groups pass. Here's what was built and what the results show.

## Outcome

I built the generation entry point from scratch (this is the baseline arm — bare, only `brief.md` + `fixtures/`, no skill mounted) and ran the full five-group test. All groups behave to contract:

| Group | Input class | Exit | Chinese stderr | Residue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 `--template 证书` | 非法 | 2 | yes | none |
| 2 `--data` nonexistent | 非法 | 2 | yes | none |
| 3 `--data` non-JSON | 非法 | 2 | yes | none |
| 4 `--data` `["数组","非对象"]` | 非法 | 2 | yes | none |
| 5 `fixtures/周报/case1.json` | 合法 | 0 | — | two artifacts |

For the legal control group, `out/周报/case1/` contains both `文书.docx` (verified a real Word 2007+ file that reopens cleanly) and `fields.json`.

## The key design decision

The brief's hardest requirement is the contrast between "illegal" and "missing required field" — missing must *not* be rejected. So I ordered the entry point as validate-everything-then-produce: template name, then data file existence, then JSON parse, then top-level-is-object, all four bail out with exit 2 before any directory is created. Only after all four pass does it call `os.makedirs`. The docx is also built fully in memory as bytes before anything touches disk, so a mid-generation failure can't leave a half-written file.

Missing fields take a separate path: they're filled with a `待定` placeholder, a hint goes to stderr, and generation proceeds with exit 0. I verified this independently of the driver's own bookkeeping — a partial input and even `{}` both produced complete artifacts at exit 0, while the four illegal groups created no `out/` directory at all.

One environment note worth flagging: `python-docx` isn't importable from the venv's default path, so `gen_doc.py` resolves it from user site-packages via a small fallback at import time. Without that the legal control group would have failed on a missing dependency rather than on its actual behavior.

## Files in place

- `gen_doc.py` — the entry point under test
- `run_cases.py` — the test driver
- `run_log.json` — per-group record: full command, exit code, stderr summary, and before/after artifact listings backing the residue check
- `out/周报/case1/文书.docx` + `fields.json` — legal control group products

Each illegal group is cleaned up after being recorded, so every group starts from a zero-residue state and the residue findings are independent rather than inherited.
